# Mock devices (`mock`)

Pretend devices of every class that live in the hub's memory. For trying Swifty Home out, and for tests.

Generated from the manifest of `plugins/mock`. The plugin's own manuals: [README](../../../../plugins/mock/README.md) (what it supports, setup) and [DEVELOPING](../../../../plugins/mock/DEVELOPING.md) (protocol notes, sources).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Version | 0.1.0 |
| Plugin API | 1 |
| Reaches | local network |
| Classes | `light`, `bridge`, `plug`, `aircon`, `speaker`, `tv`, `feeder`, `litter`, `printer`, `vm`, `host`, `router`, `camera`, `service`, `telemetry`, `other` |
| Config version | 1 |
| More than one instance | yes |
| Guided setup | yes |

## What it reaches

Nothing: it opens no socket.

## Settings

| Key | Label | Kind | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `devices` | Devices | a list of rows | yes |  | One row per pretend device. |
| `devices[].id` | Id | text, at most 64 | yes |  | The device's id within this instance: lower-case letters, digits, - and _. |
| `devices[].class` | Class | one of `light`, `bridge`, `plug`, `aircon`, `speaker`, `tv`, `feeder`, `litter`, `printer`, `vm`, `host`, `router`, `camera`, `service`, `telemetry`, `other` | yes |  | What kind of device it pretends to be. |
| `devices[].name` | Name | text, at most 64 | no |  | Its name. Left empty, a generic name for its class. |
| `devices[].target` | Target | text, at most 64 | no |  | The id to ask the hub for. Left empty, the hub picks <instance>-<id>. |
| `devices[].capabilities` | Capabilities | a list of rows | no |  | What it can do. Left out, the usual set for its class. An empty list makes it read-only. |
| `devices[].capabilities[].cap` | Capability | one of `power`, `brightness`, `color`, `volume`, `mute`, `night_mode`, `transport`, `inputs`, `keys`, `mode`, `temperature`, `fan`, `dispense`, `clean`, `print_job`, `emergency_stop`, `lifecycle`, `node_power`, `tunnel`, `metrics`, `history`, `console`, `agent_pairing`, `custom` | yes |  | Which capability. |
| `devices[].capabilities[].min` | Lowest | whole number, 0 to 255 | no |  | For brightness, the lowest level in percent (default 10). For temperature, the lowest target in °C (default 17). |
| `devices[].capabilities[].max` | Highest | whole number, 0 to 255 | no |  | For temperature, the highest target in °C (default 30). |
| `devices[].capabilities[].options` | Values | text, at most 2048 | no |  | For inputs, keys, mode, fan and dispense: the accepted values, separated by commas. Portions are in grams. |
| `devices[].capabilities[].action` | Action | text, at most 64 | no |  | For custom: the action id, mock.set_level. |
| `disabled` | Disabled because | text, at most 200 | no |  | A sentence. When set, the instance is listed as disabled with it. |
| `require_code` | Require the access code | true or false | no | `false` | When on, the instance needs its access code before it is ready. |

## Secrets

| Slot | Label | Required | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `access_code` | Access code | no | Optional. A stand-in credential, to see how the hub keeps one. The mock never shows it. |

## Custom actions

| Action | Label | Class | Tier asked | Tier applied | Idempotent | Timeout | Parameters | Confirmed by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mock.set_level` | Set a gadget's level | `other` | 1 comfort | 1 comfort | yes | 3000 ms | `level`: whole number, 0 to 10 | `{"expect":"field_equals_arg","field":"level","arg":"level"}` |

`mock.set_level`: Sets the level of a pretend gadget, a device of a class the hub has no shape for.
- Nothing real changes: the gadget lives in memory.

## Words for voice

- `gadget` names the class `other`
